sections.text: Medical implicit queries require pixel masks rather than text answers.
We introduce a supervised segmentation interface for implicit medical queries.
The image encoder and language decoder are trained with supervised mask and text losses.
On the synthetic benchmark the supervised system achieves Dice 82.5 compared with baseline Dice 78.0.
The method supports implicit medical requests but generalization to unseen modalities is not established.
